description: MUST-FAIL: float 1.0 in a digest-bearing field. This is the parsed form of JSON tokens '1.0' and '1e0'. Python json.loads -> float(1.0); Node JSON.parse -> integer 1. Same cross-implementation split as kat-24: Python rejects (FloatInDigestError); Node JCS accepts (integer 1, serializes as '1'). The defect-2 discriminating set requires 1e2/1E2/1.0/0.0 to all be present as must-fail vectors; this covers the '1.0' token form. Mutation probe: same as kat-24 (integer-valued-float relaxation would pass this).
cross_impl_note: Node.js JSON.parse('1.0') -> 1 (integer); Python json.loads('1.0') -> 1.0 (float). Our implementation rejects; Node JCS accepts.
mutation_probe: Replace `isinstance(v, float)` with `isinstance(v, float) and v != int(v)` — this vector passes (1.0 == int(1.0) = 1). The test must go red with that mutant.
